steps.title: Prepare mannan stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g of S. cerevisiae mannan (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. M7504) in 2 mL sterile PBS (Gibco, cat. 14190‑094) by gentle shaking, then add 48 mL PBS to reach a final concentration of 100 mg/mL. Avoid foam; occasional shaking is acceptable.

steps.title: Aliquot and store mannan solution
steps.instruction: Transfer the 100 mg/mL mannan solution into sterile 10 mL tubes, label, and freeze at –20 °C. The solution remains stable for >12 months when stored at this temperature.

steps.title: Acclimatize mice
steps.instruction: House 8–12‑week‑old female BALB/c mice (5–12 per group, 5 per cage) in a pathogen‑free facility with a 12 h light/12 h dark cycle, food and water ad libitum, for at least one week before any manipulation.

steps.title: Thaw mannan‑PBS working solution
steps.instruction: Remove 1 mL of the 100 mg/mL mannan‑PBS stock from –20 °C, let it sit at room temperature for 15 min. Avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles; the volume needed depends on the number of mice.

steps.title: Remove hair from back skin
steps.instruction: Shave a 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm area on the dorsal skin using a mouse shaver with a 2.4 cm blade (cuts to ~0.1 mm depth). Apply hair‑removal cream (Nair, cat. 657789) on a smooth plastic plate, spread over the shaved area, wait 20 min, then wipe off with a paper towel.

steps.title: Anesthetize mice with phenobarbital
steps.instruction: Weigh each mouse to the nearest 0.1 g. Prepare phenobarbital‑normal saline solution (80 mg/mL phenobarbital, Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. 57‑30‑7, dissolved in normal saline; 5 mL contains 400 mg phenobarbital). Inject intraperitoneally ≤200 µL per mouse.

steps.title: Prepare mannan‑IFA mixture
steps.instruction: Mix 100 µL of the thawed mannan‑PBS solution (now 50 mg/mL) with 100 µL incomplete Freund’s adjuvant (IFA, Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. F5506‑10) in a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube. Pipette gently until an emulsion forms. Prepare fresh for each experiment and ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Apply mixture to mouse back
steps.instruction: Using a cotton swab pre‑soaked in PBS (or a fine natural/synthetic brush, not foam), spread a thin, uniform layer of the mannan‑IFA emulsion over the shaved 2.0 cm × 3.5 cm area. Apply exactly 50 µL of the mixture per mouse; avoid pooling.

steps.title: Repeat application for three days
steps.instruction: Perform the mixture preparation (previous step) and skin application each morning between 09:00–10:00 am for three consecutive days, maintaining a 24‑hour interval between applications.

steps.title: Include PBS control group
steps.instruction: Treat a matched group of mice (minimum five) with 50 µL of sterile PBS applied to the same skin area using the same method and schedule.

steps.title: Score lesions daily (PASI)
steps.instruction: Starting 48 h after the first application, assess each mouse daily for up to 9 days. Record redness, scales, and thickness on a 0–4 scale (total max 12). Measure skin thickness with a digital vernier caliper (0.1 mm = 1 score above naïve skin). Use the PASI table for reference.

substeps.instruction: Gently lift the mouse from its cage and observe the dorsal skin.
Measure thickness at the same site and angle with the caliper; assign a 0‑4 score.
Record the total PASI score (sum of three parameters).

steps.title: IMQ‑induced psoriasis protocol (optional)
steps.instruction: Divide one 250 mg Aldara™ cream (Imiquimod, cat. 678432) pack into five equal portions. For the IMQ group, after hair removal and phenobarbital anesthesia (as above), apply 50 mg of IMQ cream to the same dorsal area each morning between 09:00–10:00 am for five consecutive days (24 h interval). Use a fine brush, apply a thin coat, and avoid excess. Score lesions daily with the PASI method before each new application.

steps.title: Collect skin samples for histology
steps.instruction: On the designated day (e.g., day 4), excise a 2 cm × 3.5 cm piece of dorsal skin from each mouse. Immediately submerge in 4 % paraformaldehyde (Leagene, cat. DF0135) and fix for 24 h at 4 °C. Afterwards, cut the tissue into 1 cm × 1 cm pieces.

steps.title: Dehydrate tissues (graded ethanol)
steps.instruction: Process the 1 cm × 1 cm pieces through the following ethanol series (total ≈12 h):

substeps.instruction: Transfer to xylene (Beyotime, cat. C0105) – two changes, 10 min each, to clear.
Immerse in 75 °C liquid paraffin oil (Yuanye, cat. 67552) – two changes, 2 h each.

steps.title: Embed and section tissue
steps.instruction: Place the cleared pieces into a plastic paraffin‑embedding cassette, allow paraffin to solidify, then cut longitudinal sections 8 µm thick with a microtome at room temperature. Store sections on plus‑loaded slides (Thermo Fisher, cat. 6885) at –20 °C until staining.

steps.title: H&E staining (Support Protocol 3)
steps.instruction: Perform the following steps on each slide:

substeps.instruction: Deparaffinize in xylene – two changes, 10 min each.
Stain with Mayer’s hematoxylin (Beyotime, cat. C0105) for 8 min.
Rinse in running tap water for 5 min.
If overstained, dip briefly in 1 % H₂O₂ in 70 % ethanol.
Counterstain with 0.2 % eosin in PBS (Beyotime, cat. C0105) for 2 min.
Clear in xylene – two changes, 5 min each.
Mount with a xylene‑based mounting medium (HistoLab, cat. 00801) and cover with a coverslip.

steps.title: Measure epidermal thickness
steps.instruction: Using an eclipse upright optical microscope, capture images (≥20×) of at least five different areas per skin section. Open Image‑Pro Plus 6.0 (Nikon), set the scale with a known ruler line (global setting), then use the line tool to measure epidermal thickness at each point. Collect at least 10 measurements per image, from three mice per group (≥30 measurements per group). Analyze data with GraphPad Prism 5 (unpaired t‑test) and report mean ± SEM.

substeps.instruction: Select the line tool and draw a line of known length on the ruler image.
Choose Analyze → Set Scale, input the known length and unit, check ‘Global’, click OK.
Measure each epidermal segment by drawing a line across the thickness.
Press Ctrl + M to record each measurement.
Repeat for all selected fields, then export data for statistical analysis.

description: Validation of protocol The severity of mannan-induced skin inflammation was much higher than imiquimod-induced psoriasis-like skin inflammation ( Wu et al., 2023 ), and female mice developed more severe psoriasis symptoms than males ( Wu et al., 2022 ). Neutrophil cytosol factor ( Ncf1 ), which encodes p47phox, is critically involved in NADPH oxidase 2 (NOX2) complex formation. The NOX2 complex is responsible for the induction of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and is an essential regulator of several autoimmune diseases. Epicutaneous exposure to mannan induced a severe, aggravated disease in mice having either spontaneous Ncf1 m1J mutation or Ncf 90H mice having a major human single nucleotide variant on the Ncf1 gene, causing an amino acid replacement from arginine to histidine at position 90 ( Li et al., 2023 ).
